name: Cinematic character poster
desc: A large main portrait with three small characters and amber light behind. A poster layout for film, game and character reviews.

CHARACTER.label: Main person
CHARACTER.default: a film director with a determined look

CAST.label: Three supporting people or characters
CAST.default: a young hero, a mysterious rival and an old mentor

WORLD.label: Setting of the film or story
WORLD.default: a misty desert city and distant sand dunes

style.custom: Movie-poster portrait montage: one dominant portrait at left, three much smaller supporting portraits on the right. Amber backlight, black clothing, no generated lettering.
